definitions.short: Areli (or an Arelite, collectively), an Israelite and his descendants
definitions.full: H692. Areli אַרְאֵלִי proper name, masculine (apparently noun, of a people from foregoing, but ᵐ5 Num 26:17 Ἀριηλ ( Gen 46:16 Ἀροηλεις , Ἀροηδις , Ἀπηδεις ) = foregoing) a son of Gad 46:16 ; Num 26:17 ; also adjective, of a people with article as proper name collective Num 26:17 ᵐ5 הָאַרְאֵלִי מִשְׁמַּחַת Ἀριηλει .
